description_en: Expands the cache disk of a Cloud Storage Gateway
name: ExpandCacheDisk

parameters.help_en:
The capacity of the cache disk after it is scaled out. Unit: GB. The following requirements must be met:

The capacity of the cache disk after it is scaled out cannot be smaller than the original capacity. You cannot scale in a cache disk.
The maximum capacity of a cache disk for a Basic gateway is 4 TB. The maximum capacity of a cache disk for a Medium gateway is 8 TB. The maximum capacity of a cache disk for an Enhanced or Performance gateway is 32 TB.
The minimum capacity of a cache disk for a file gateway is 40 GB. The minimum capacity of a cache disk for an iSCSI gateway is 20 GB
parameters.help_zh:
扩容后的缓存容量。单位为GB。扩容要求如下：

扩容后的缓存盘容量不能比原先缓存盘的容量小，即不支持缩减缓存盘。

基础型网关扩容缓存盘上限为4 TB，标准型网关扩容缓存盘上限为8 TB，增强型和性能型网关扩容缓存盘上限为32 TB。

文件网关缓存盘扩容下限为40 GB，块网关缓存盘扩容下限为20 GB
parameters.name: new_size_in_gb

parameters.help_en: The internal device name of the cache disk. You can call the DescribeGatewayCaches operation to query the internal device name of the cache disk
parameters.help_zh: 缓存盘内部设备名。您可以通过DescribeGatewayCaches接口获得缓存盘内部设备名
parameters.name: local_file_path

BuyURL.description_en: The URL that is used to pay for the subscription cache disk
BuyURL.description_zh: 缓存盘为预付费情况下的购买支付链接
